ggplot2 theme for spatial plots

Source: R/SpatialUtils.R
theme_spatial.Rd

Built on theme_scop() with axes, ticks, and panel grid hidden by default. Spatial plot helpers default to theme_use = "theme_spatial".

Usage

theme_spatial(show_axes = FALSE, aspect.ratio = 1, base_size = 12, ...)

Arguments

show_axes

Whether to keep axis titles, text, ticks, and grid lines.

aspect.ratio

Aspect ratio of the panel.

base_size

Base font size

...

Arguments passed to the ggplot2::theme.

Value

A ggplot2 theme object (class theme, gg).

See also

theme_scop()

Examples

theme_spatial()

#>  $ text                 : <ggplot2::element_text>
#>   ..@ family       : NULL
